text: Youth Protection Training (YPT) must be renewed annually. Check your expiration at my.scouting.org.
Two-deep leadership required at ALL scout activities — in person and virtual.
Record advancement completions in Scoutbook promptly after each meeting.
All expenditures over $50 require committee approval before purchasing.
Leaders, please try out features here.  Add, Edit, try to break.  We can modify to our hearts content so lets make this as useful as possible.  Thanks!
